primary_publication.title: Open data for Moroccan license plates for OCR applications : data collection, labeling, and model construction

public_source_review.interpretation: The paper licence and a public download do not by themselves prove rights for separately distributed image archives or provide full-plate OCR truth.

decision.reason: No exact dataset-archive licence proof or plate-level sequence manifest was established by the public audit.

admission_requirements: obtain the original dataset archive with an explicit licence applying to images and annotations
freeze the archive hash and licence proof in the private evidence register
verify a plate-level sequence manifest rather than treating character boxes as full-plate OCR truth
deduplicate by vehicle or scene against every consumed development source
keep any admitted real OCR development data disjoint from the future final holdout

minimum_controls: private storage and private integrity manifest
Arabic letters, Latin letters and digits represented
plate detector crop required before recognition
